1. Maren goes down to the tidal flats at dawn to dig clams.
2. She watches a heron hunt along the channel while she works.
3. The digging is slow; she takes stock of her own tiredness.
4. The tide turns and begins to come back in.
5. She fills the bucket with enough for chowder.
6. She climbs the levee and speaks to the day before heading home.
